rows.grounds: future verb expressing the speaker's intended declaration
locative adverb referring to the stated context
locative indicating the initial point of the procedure
compound object denoting three praṇava syllables; praṇava kept as mantra term

items.question: Which mantra element must be declared first in that context?
premises: The speaker announces an intended declaration.
The declaration is situated in that context.
The initial element specified is a triad of praṇavas.
items.inference: Therefore, the procedure begins with the declaration of three praṇavas.
uncertainties: The grammatical gender of ādau is taken as masculine, though neuter is also possible.
items.plain_english: There, at the beginning, I shall declare the three praṇavas.
